**Claude:** Both symptoms traced to `.storybook/preview.ts`. Reproduced locally, fixed, and verified against a real build.

## Root causes

**Blank Design System pages.** `preview.ts` used `definePreview()`, which makes it a *CSF-factory* preview. Storybook's Vite builder generates project annotations two different ways ([`chunk-MXVJKK5Y.js:378`](node_modules/@storybook/builder-vite/dist/_node-chunks/chunk-MXVJKK5Y.js)): the non-factory branch composes every `previewAnnotations` contributed by `main.ts` `addons`, but the factory branch emits only `preview.default.composed` and **discards them all**. So `@storybook/addon-docs`'s preview parameters — which supply `parameters.docs.renderer` — never reached the preview. I confirmed this: `excludeFromDocsStories`, a string unique to addon-docs' preview chunk, was absent from every built bundle.

The real page error was `TypeError: i.renderer is not a function`. The `Illegal invocation` you saw was downstream: `storybook/internal/csf` replaces `HTMLElement.prototype.focus` with an accessor whose getter reads `this.ownerDocument`; react-aria (bundled into `@storybook/components`, used by the error UI) reads `focus` **off the prototype**, so `this` is `HTMLElement.prototype` and Chrome throws. It disappears once docs render normally.

**Missing styles.** `preview.ts` never imported `src/styles/global.css`, so the iframe had no Tailwind layer and no CSS variables.

## Changes

- `.storybook/preview.ts` — register `addonDocs()` and `addonThemes()` in `addons`; import `../src/styles/global.css`.
- `LinkButton.stories.ts`, `Tag.stories.ts` — `render: () => ({ Component, props, slots })` is a shape the Astro renderer rejects ("Expecting an HTML snippet or DOM node"). Slots belong in `args`. `MultipleTags` → `InListContext` with a `<ul>` decorator.
- `Comments`/`GoogleMapsStats`/`UnsplashStats` stories — added `parameters.renderer: "react"`; they were failing with `Renderer 'astro' not found`.
- `tsconfig.json`, `eslint.config.js`, `.prettierignore` — exclude `public/styleguide`. This one is load-bearing: **`npm run build` was crashing**, because `astro check` type-checked the minified Storybook bundle and died with `FATAL ERROR: Reached heap limit`. ESLint was also reporting 10,573 errors from it (now 38).
- `Hr.stories.ts` — `Meta`/`StoryObj` aren't exported by `storybook/internal/types`; this was the last `astro check` error, previously masked by the OOM.

`astro check` now reports 0 errors; all 37 index entries render.

## Left unfixed

- **`BackButton` and `Header` client scripts 404.** The static prerender emits `<script type="module" src="D:/W/.../BackButton.astro?astro&type=script...">` — an absolute filesystem path. Markup renders correctly; only the client-side behaviour doesn't run. This is a `@storybook-astro/framework` limitation (Astro's container API doesn't bundle hoisted scripts), not something fixable in this repo.
- `EditPost/Hidden` and `Pagination/SinglePage` render empty **by design** — both components return nothing in those states.
- Comments/UnsplashStats log network 404/401 (Giscus, and Unsplash without a real key).
- `npm run format:check` still fails on pre-existing files I didn't touch (`.github/**`, `public/blogs/**`, `src/pages/**`), including a genuine HTML syntax error in `public/blogs/personal/photography/men-at-work/index.html`. ESLint's remaining 38 unused-variable errors are likewise pre-existing.

One note: `pnpm` isn't on this machine's PATH, so I installed with `npm`. No lockfile changed.
